text: Hi, Professor. Can I talk to you for a minute? Sure, what’s going on? I’m having some trouble with my group project. One person hasn’t been doing their portion of the project. That sounds like a difficult situation. Have you talked to this person about it? Yeah, I’ve tried, but they haven’t provided any reasons for why their work isn’t complete yet. Okay, have you tried asking them to have their section done by a certain date? Giving them a deadline that’s earlier than the actual due date for the project might help. Yeah, I’ve tried that, too, but they haven’t been able to meet the deadline. Okay, I can talk to your group member to see if there’s a problem. Don’t worry about it for now, just focus on your section of the project. Okay, thank you for your help, Professor!
